outcome: Give Telco teams a working Network & Field-Asset Predictive Maintenance capability on their own data — it reduces outage minutes and emergency dispatches.
overview: An unplanned site failure costs an operator three ways at once: SLA penalties, subscriber experience in the affected cells, and an emergency truck-roll priced far above a scheduled visit. Network & Field-Asset Predictive Maintenance reads alarm and equipment telemetry continuously, learns what degradation looks like before it becomes an outage, and produces a ranked worklist that field planning can schedule against — moving maintenance from reactive dispatch to planned work. The NOC keeps the call on what gets dispatched and when. Five to six weeks on the operator's own alarm history and work-order records establishes whether MTTR and unplanned outage hours actually fall against baseline.
